memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Type 2 diabetes mellitus, psoriasis, and allergic asthma.
Patient reports polyuria, occasional thirst, mild scalp plaques, and intermittent wheeze on exertion. Examination: BMI 28, BP 130/84, lung fields clear with mild expiratory wheeze, psoriasis plaques on elbows and knees, no retinal changes visualized. Spirometry: FEV1 2.45 L (78% pred), FVC 3.10 L (82% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.79; change from prior not applicable. ACT score 16 (not well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking: never.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 7.8% (ref 4.0-5.6). Fasting plasma glucose 158 mg/dL (ref 70-99). Urine albumin‑creatinine ratio 22 mg/g (ref <30).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Dilated fundus exam: no microaneurysms, no hemorrhages, macula normal. Cup‑disc ratio 0.3 bilaterally.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Type 2 diabetes mellitus, psoriasis, allergic asthma – stable.
Reports improved polyuria, mild scalp itch, occasional night‑time wheeze. Exam: BP 128/82, lungs clear, mild wheeze at bases, psoriasis plaques unchanged, no pedal edema. Spirometry: FEV1 2.55 L (82% pred) ↑0.10 L, FVC 3.15 L, FEV1/FVC 0.81. ACT score 20 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking: never.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: HbA1c 7.2% (ref 4.0-5.6). Fasting plasma glucose 132 mg/dL (ref 70-99). ALT 28 U/L (ref ≤40). AST 26 U/L (ref ≤40). CBC: Hb 13.8 g/dL, WBC 6.2×10⁹/L, Plt 210×10⁹/L. Serum creatinine 0.92 mg/dL (ref 0.6-1.2).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Type 2 diabetes mellitus, psoriasis, allergic asthma – review.
Patient notes occasional daytime dyspnoea, mild increase in scalp scaling. Exam: BP 130/84, lungs with mild expiratory wheeze, psoriasis plaques slightly thicker on knees, no new skin lesions. Spirometry: FEV1 2.48 L (80% pred) ↓0.07 L from last, FVC 3.08 L, FEV1/FVC 0.80. ACT score 18 (not well controlled). Technique corrected: taught slow‑deep inhalation for dry powder device; inspiratory flow adequate. Smoking: never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Spirometry with reversibility: pre‑bronchodilator FEV1 2.48 L (80% pred), FVC 3.08 L, FEV1/FVC 0.80. Post‑salbutamol FEV1 2.71 L (88% pred), ↑0.23 L (9.3%); significant reversibility noted.

Type 2 diabetes mellitus, psoriasis, allergic asthma – stable on current regimen.
Reports good glycaemic control, less scalp itch, no nocturnal wheeze. Exam: BP 126/80, lungs clear, psoriasis plaques mild, no edema. Spirometry: FEV1 2.52 L (81% pred) ↑0.04 L, FVC 3.12 L, FEV1/FVC 0.81. ACT score 22 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking: never.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Type 2 diabetes mellitus, psoriasis, allergic asthma – final review.
Patient asymptomatic; HbA1c at target, psoriasis mild, asthma well controlled. Exam: BP 124/78, lungs clear, psoriasis plaques minimal, no retinopathy signs. Spirometry: FEV1 2.58 L (83% pred) ↑0.06 L, FVC 3.18 L, FEV1/FVC 0.81. ACT score 24 (well controlled). Technique checked: correct. Smoking: never. Plan: continue current meds, repeat labs in 3 months.
